product_metadata.title: The Nyche Designs Crisscross Adjustable Bed Sheet Straps Suspenders Model W1 (Set of 2, White)
features: VERSATILITY - Multi-functional. The straps will stretch from 60" to approximately 148". Fit to various beds. Perfect for fitted or flat sheets.
DURABILITY - Made of sturdy chrome metal clips and heavy duty wide elastic bands.
PROTECTION - Built-in plastic clenching system protects fabric from harm.
INNOVATION - Improved length adjustment lock enables easier and quicker adjustment on cord length to generate desired tension.

SUPERSAVER - See below for promotional combo offers. These work greatly with Nyche Designs Adjustable Bed Sheet Fasteners. (i.e. Crisscross side to side, Adjustable Bed Sheet Fasteners at the corners))
description: Nyche Designs focuses on bedding accessories that make your life easier. Use sheet fasteners and never worry about messy or wrinkled sheets again. They secure fitted sheets, flat sheets, mattress pads, and even ironing board covers. They are easy to use and keep your bed looking great at all times. Our sheet fasteners are made of durable GRADE A heavy-duty elastic. Set of 2 are included per package. We also have assorted bedding accessories and gadgets to meet your special need please see in our storefront.
